verdict.rationale: Modal is a GPU compute platform, so a spot or interruptible pricing tier is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack does not document any discounted spot or preemptible GPU tier, or any preemption semantics. The pricing evidence covers only usage-based billing, workspace budgets, marketplace committed spend and credits, which are adjacent billing features rather than spot capacity.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can rent spot or interruptible GPU capacity at a deep discount with clearly documented preemption semantics
